hero_subhead: Boiler broken in Coventry? We arrive within the hour. Same-day repairs, no hidden charges, fully guaranteed.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Coventry
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full installations, we handle every heating and plumbing need with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Your boiler's packed in at the worst possible time. We diagnose and fix most faults same day — even weekends and evenings — so you're never left without heat.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler efficient and safe. We catch small problems before they become expensive breakdowns, and it maintains your warranty.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrading to a modern condensing boiler cuts your heating bills by up to 35%. We handle the full install, including paperwork and a 10-year manufacturer guarantee.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes — we fix them quickly. We can also upgrade to more efficient models to improve your home's warmth and cut costs.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Planning a new central heating system? We design, install, and commission complete systems tailored to your home, with all necessary certification included.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs & Maintenance
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, blocked drains, and taps that won't stop dripping — we fix all your plumbing problems with minimal fuss and maximum speed.

about_pullquote: I started this to give people honest, fair-priced heating work without the nonsense.
about_para_1: Rob established Rob.mc Plumbing and Heating over 15 years ago to provide Coventry homeowners with straightforward, reliable heating and plumbing solutions. What began as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local business, built on showing up on time, doing the job right, and charging a fair price. Every engineer carries parts on the van and is Gas Safe registered — no excuses, no delays.
about_para_2: Hundreds of Coventry families rely on us for their boiler repairs and heating needs because we answer the phone, turn up when we say we will, and explain everything in plain English. We're not interested in hard-sell upsells or surprise bills. You get honest advice, transparent pricing, and work you can trust — that's why customers come back to us year after year, and why they recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Rob.mc

reviews.text: Our boiler went out on a freezing Saturday evening. Called Rob and he was here within 45 minutes. Turned out it was a dodgy thermostat — he replaced it and charged us a fair price. No messing about. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced by Rob's team. Polite lads, knew what they were doing, and they spotted a small leak before it became a problem. Good value and no pressure to replace anything that didn't need it.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Installed a new condensing boiler at our place last year. Rob explained the whole process and the paperwork was all sorted. It's made a real difference to our heating bills. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
